# Valencia Theater Seating

> > Premium Italian leather home theater seating and luxury furniture featuring advanced comfort technologies and made-to-order craftsmanship.

Valencia specializes in high-end home theater seating using Italian Nappa 11,000 leather, alongside complementary living room furniture, bedding, and home decor. Products feature innovative comfort systems from Leggett & Platt, sustainable materials like TENCEL Lyocell, and customizable configurations for dedicated home cinema rooms.

## Key Topics

- Italian Nappa 11,000 Top Grain Leather
- Home Theater Seating
- Leggett & Platt Mechanisms
- Power Reclining Sectionals
- TENCEL Lyocell
- OEKO-TEX Certified Materials
- Aniline Leather
- Cloud Silque Bedding
- Made-to-Order Furniture
- CPS Extended Warranty
- Zero Wall Recliner Technology
- LED Lighting Integration
- Machine-Washable Textiles
- Comfort-Matrix Seating
- Luxury Living Room Furniture
